anti_overlap: fd-deontic-defeasible-hierarchy covers the logical formalism for rule hierarchies, not the annotation file format
fd-snorkel-programmatic-labeling covers automated label generation from comments, not the schema design itself
fd-dual-encoder-editorial covers embedding architecture, not annotation format standards
decision_lens: Prioritizes schema designs that are (a) losslessly representable in standard formats for tooling reuse, (b) capable of handling overlapping and hierarchical spans without structural hacks, and (c) compatible with active open-source annotation tooling as of 2025.
focus: Computational linguistics annotation standards (LAF, GrAF, NLP-Interchange Format) for designing the v2 editorial judgment annotation schema
name: fd-laf-graf-annotation-schema
persona: A computational linguist specializing in annotation interoperability, standoff annotation, and multi-layer corpus design. Reads LAW workshop proceedings, LREC-COLING, and ISO TC 37/SC 4 standards. Has hands-on experience with GrAF, WebAnno, INCEpTION, and CATMA.
review_areas: Audit ISO 24612 (LAF) and GrAF graph model for encoding multi-layer editorial annotations: span-level edits, sentence-level rationales, document-level style judgments — identify minimum viable schema
Survey 2024-2025 LREC-COLING annotation papers for multi-label, graded, and uncertain annotation schemes (especially crowdsourced disagreement modeling) applicable to 7K editor comments
Research INCEpTION 2024-2025 feature set and CATMA 6+ for whether they support the required annotation layers without custom extensions — practical tooling decision
Examine NLP-Interchange Format (NIF) and WebAnnotation W3C spec extensions for linking before/after text spans across document versions — critical for diff-anchored annotations
Find 2024-2026 papers on annotation schema versioning and backward compatibility (schema evolution) — needed since v2 schema must coexist with existing v1 annotations
Survey computational linguistics papers on inter-annotator agreement for subjective/graded tasks (e.g., MQM extensions, ESA) to build reliability metrics into the v2 schema design
success_hints: A concrete LAF/GrAF or WebAnnotation JSON-LD schema skeleton for the v2 editorial judgment layers, with explicit nodes for: edit span, edit type, rationale, rule invoked, confidence
Identification of which 2025-era annotation tool (INCEpTION, CATMA, Label Studio extension) best supports the required multi-layer diff-anchored structure out of the box
task_context: A self-improving editorial AI has 23K before/after editing pairs with 7K editor comments. Phase 2 requires annotation schema design, weak supervision from comments, a defeasible rule hierarchy, and dual-encoder embeddings for editorial similarity.
